profile.modeSingleDesc: The site uses only one game ID. Renaming or switching IDs requires a 30-day gap, matching Minecraft's official behaviour.
profile.modeMultiDesc: You can hold several game IDs and switch freely with no cooldown. Only one ID is active for login at any time.
profile.reservedHint: These IDs are kept but currently unavailable — they do not appear in the launcher's profile list. Once the cooldown ends you can move one of them back here.
profile.modeChooseKeepRequired: Pick the game ID you want to keep first
profile.modeFirstChoice: Choose the game ID to keep
profile.modeFirstChoiceHint: This site is currently in single-username mode and your account has several game IDs. Pick which one to keep: the chosen ID stays usable, the rest become locked (names and data are kept; nobody else can take them). Until you choose, actions such as renaming and creating profiles are temporarily blocked.
profile.modeKeepHint: The other {{count}} ID(s) become locked — names and data are kept, they can be swapped back in after the cooldown, and locked IDs appear as taken to everyone.
profile.poolHint: All of your profile names. Locked IDs remain occupied by you — nobody else can register or use them. Activating a locked ID is subject to the 30-day cooldown.
profile.poolAddSuccess: Profile {{name}} added and ready to use
profile.poolCooldownHint: ID change is cooling down: {{days}} day(s) remaining. Locked IDs cannot be activated yet.
profile.reservedActivateFailed: Failed to switch to that ID
profile.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address
profile.backupEmailExplain: The backup email lets you recover your account if the primary one stops working. Click the link in the email to verify it; it must differ from your primary email.
profile.backupEmailSent: Verification email sent to {{email}} — click the link in it to finish
profile.backupEmailNotSent: A backup email is already awaiting verification. Finish it first or try again later.
profile.backupEmailFailed: Failed to send the backup email verification message
profile.backupAlreadyVerified: Backup email already verified; no need to resend
profile.backupRemoveFailed: Failed to unlink the backup email
profile.removeBackupConfirm: Unlink the backup email? It will no longer be usable for account recovery or authorising email changes.
profile.backupRecommended: Adding a backup email is recommended, so you can still recover your account if the primary one fails.
profile.changePrimaryExplain: Changing the primary email needs two confirmations: one sent to the new address (proving you can receive it) and one sent to your other email (proving it is really you). The change takes effect only after both, and a notice is then sent to the old address.
profile.changeBackupExplain: Changing the backup email needs two confirmations: one sent to the new address and one sent to your primary email. The change takes effect only after both.
profile.changeMailVerifyTo: ① To the new address: {{email}} — click the link to prove you can receive it
profile.changeMailAuthorizeTo: ② To the authorising mailbox: {{email}} — click the link to approve this change
profile.changeFallbackToSelf: You have no verified backup email yet, so both emails went to your current primary address. Consider adding a backup email as a fallback.
profile.pendingAutoCheck: This page checks the progress automatically; you can also click “Check now”.
profile.cancelChangeConfirm: Cancel this email change? Links already sent will stop working immediately.
profile.changeEmailWaiting: Still waiting for the other email's confirmation
profile.resetLinkSentDesc: Open the link in the email to set a new password on the new page.
profile.resetLinkValidity: The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used only once.
profile.resetLinkHint: The email contains a one-time link; clicking it opens a new page to set your password.
profile.nameChangeCooldown: Name change on cooldown: available in {{days}} days
profile.supportsYggdrasil: Supports launchers with Yggdrasil like HMCL, PCL2
profile.dragInstruction: Drag method: hold the green button above and drag directly into the authentication server addition area of HMCL / PCL2 launcher
profile.manualInstruction: Manual method: copy the API address above and paste it in the launcher to add
profile.afterAdding: After adding successfully, log in with your email and password
profile.manageSecurity: Manage your account security settings, including changing password or recovering password via email verification.
profile.cannotRecover: This operation cannot be recovered, please operate with caution.
profile.accountAndAllData: your account and all data, and cannot be recovered.
profile.skinsAndCapes: • All uploaded skin and cape files

setup.welcome: Welcome to the Skin Server Setup Wizard
setup.welcomeDesc:
This wizard will guide you through the initial server configuration.
The entire process only takes a few minutes.
setup.defaultLanguageHint: This is the initial language visitors see. They can still switch it later.
setup.dbTypeIrreversible: Warning: the database type cannot be changed once installation is complete. SQLite needs no extra setup and suits a single machine; PostgreSQL requires your own database service and suits high concurrency. Choose carefully.
setup.dbPasswordOptional: Optional — leave empty for local or trust authentication
setup.sqliteHint: Will use SQLite database. Data files are stored locally on the server, no additional configuration needed.
setup.redisDesc: Enabling Redis can improve website access speed. If not enabled, memory cache will be used.
setup.redisNoHint: Redis cache is not enabled. The system will use memory cache, which is cleared after restart. Suitable for personal or low-traffic sites.
setup.mailDesc: Used for sending verification emails and password reset emails. Pre-filled with NetEase email format.
setup.confirmDesc: Please confirm the following information is correct. Click "Start Installation" to complete the configuration.
setup.installCompleteDesc: Your skin server is ready to use.
setup.activatingDesc: The completion signal was received. The server is applying settings and restarting — please wait…
setup.autoRedirectDesc: Configuration is live. This page will refresh automatically in a few seconds.
setup.activateTimeoutDesc: The server has not become active after 90 seconds. Installation itself completed — use the button below to continue manually.
